note: Duas sourced; daily companion data. Ramadan's dates come from the app's own Umm al-Qura calendar, not from this file; confirm by local moon sighting. Arabic of hadith duas was checked against the hadith-api text and Qur'an duas against the bundled Qur'an; every transliteration is a learning aid flagged for scholar review.

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
days.text: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah (said on sighting the new moon).
days.source: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3451 — da'if per Zubair Ali Zai; sahih per al-Albani; al-Tirmidhi called it hasan gharib
days.translit: Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-yumni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-islam, rabbi wa rabbukallah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: وَبِصَوْمِ غَدٍ نَّوَيْتُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
days.text: I intend the fast of tomorrow from the month of Ramadan.
days.source: Customary wording, not a narrated text — the intention (niyyah) is made in the heart. The ruling that the fast needs an intention before dawn: Sunan Abi Dawud 2454 (sahih per al-Albani)
days.translit: Wa bi-sawmi ghadin nawaytu min shahri Ramadan.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: تَسَحَّرُوا فَإِنَّ فِي السَّحُورِ بَرَكَةً
days.text: Eat suhoor, for in suhoor there is blessing.
days.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 1923
days.translit: Tasahharu fa inna fis-suhuri barakah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
days.text: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
days.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 2357 — hasan per al-Albani
days.translit: Dhahabaz-zama'u wabtallatil-'uruqu wa thabatal-ajru in sha'allah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنَّا عَلَى صِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ
days.text: O Allah, help us fast it and stand in prayer through it.
days.source: General supplication (not a hadith) — permissible in your own words
days.translit: Allahumma a'inna 'ala siyamihi wa qiyamih.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.theme: Good in this world and the next
days.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٗ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةٗ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
days.text: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
days.source: Qur'an 2:201 · the Prophet's most frequent supplication: Sahih al-Bukhari 6389
days.translit: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
days.text: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
days.source: Qur'an 17:24
days.translit: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ
days.text: O Allah, I ask You to enable me to do good deeds, to leave evil deeds, and to love the poor.
days.source: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3235 — hasan sahih per al-Tirmidhi; sahih per al-Albani
days.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khayrat, wa tarkal-munkarat, wa hubbal-masakin.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قُلُوبِنَا
days.text: O Allah, make the Qur'an the spring of our hearts.
days.source: General supplication — reported in Musnad Ahmad; check the grade with a scholar before relying on this wording
days.translit: Allahummaj'alil-qur'ana rabi'a qulubina.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ
days.text: O Allah, help me remember You, thank You, and worship You well.
days.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 1522, sahih per al-Albani
days.translit: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
days.text: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, besides whom none has the right to be worshipped — the Ever-Living, the Sustainer — and I repent to Him.
days.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 1517 — sahih per al-Albani
days.translit: Astaghfirullahal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyumu wa atubu ilayh.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي
days.text: Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind, and heal — You are the Healer.
days.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 5675
days.translit: Adh-hibil-ba's, rabban-nas, washfi anta ash-shafi.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا
days.text: Our Lord, pour upon us patience.
days.source: Qur'an 2:250
days.translit: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabra.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
days.text: Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.
days.source: Qur'an 3:173
days.translit: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.theme: The guest's barakah (said to a host)
days.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ
days.text: May the fasting break their fast with you, and the righteous eat your food, and the angels pray for you.
days.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 3854, sahih per al-Albani
days.translit: Aftara 'indakumus-sa'imun, wa akala ta'amakumul-abrar, wa sallat 'alaykumul-mala'ikah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ
days.text: I seek protection for you in the perfect words of Allah.
days.source: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 2060, hasan sahih per al-Tirmidhi and sahih per al-Albani; Sunan Abi Dawud 4737, sahih per al-Albani (Sahih al-Bukhari 3371 has the same words in the first person, 'A`udhu')
days.translit: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي بِالْقُرْآنِ
days.text: O Allah, have mercy on me through the Qur'an.
days.source: General supplication (not a hadith) — permissible in your own words
days.translit: Allahummarhamni bil-qur'an.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
days.text: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
days.source: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3522, hasan per Darussalam
days.translit: Ya muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنَّا عَلَى الْعِتْقِ فِي رَمَضَانَ
days.text: O Allah, help us to attain freedom from the Fire in this Ramadan.
days.source: General supplication (not a hadith) — permissible in your own words
days.translit: Allahumma a'inna 'alal-'itqi fi Ramadan.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: نَوَيْتُ الِاعْتِكَافَ لِلَّهِ
days.text: I intend the spiritual retreat for Allah.
days.source: Customary wording, not a narrated text — the intention is made in the heart
days.translit: Nawaytul-i'tikafa lillah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.theme: Odd nights: the dua of Laylat al-Qadr
days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
days.text: O Allah, You are Pardoning and love to pardon — pardon me.
days.source: Sunan Ibn Majah 3850 — da'if per Zubair Ali Zai; sahih per al-Albani. Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3513 has the same with 'Karim' (Generous) after 'afuwwun' — hasan sahih per al-Tirmidhi
days.translit: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.theme: For yourself, your parents and the believers
days.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ
days.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women.
days.source: Qur'an 71:28 (Nuh's prayer, without its last clause)
days.translit: Rabbigh-fir li wa liwalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا
days.text: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as Messenger.
days.source: Sunan Abi Dawud 1529 — sahih per al-Albani
days.translit: Raditu billahi rabba, wa bil-islami dina, wa bi-muhammadin rasula.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
days.text: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
days.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6384
days.translit: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ
days.text: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes.
days.source: Qur'an 25:74
days.translit: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yun.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْشِفِ الْبَلَاءَ عَنِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
days.text: O Allah, lift the trials from the Muslims everywhere.
days.source: General supplication (not a hadith) — permissible in your own words
days.translit: Allahummakshifil-bala'a 'anil-muslimin.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.theme: The grand night: pardon and well-being
days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
days.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
days.source: Sunan Ibn Majah 3871 — sahih per al-Albani (the Prophet ﷺ never left it morning or evening)
days.translit: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُخْرِجَ زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرِ عَنِّي وَعَمَّنْ أَعُولُ
days.text: I intend to give zakat al-fitr for myself and my dependents.
days.source: Customary wording, not a narrated text — the intention is made in the heart
days.translit: Nawaytu an ukhrija zakatal-fitri 'anni wa 'amman a'ul.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ صِيَامِنَا
days.text: O Allah, do not let this be the last of our Ramadans — accept it from us.
days.source: General supplication (not a hadith) — permissible in your own words
days.translit: Allahumma la taj'alhu akhiral-'ahdi min siyamina.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review

days.arabic: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ
days.text: May Allah accept from us and from you.
days.source: Eid greeting of the Companions — reported by Jubayr ibn Nufayr; chain graded hasan by Ibn Hajar (Fath al-Bari)
days.translit: Taqabbalallahu minna wa minkum.
days.translitSource: Author's letter-by-letter rendering of the Arabic; a learning aid, for scholar review
